battleCap: The word spirits are resting for today. You can still visit the School, Reading Hall, Inn, Shop, or Spirit Book.
peaceful: Every spirit in this lesson is Gold and resting.
readingComplete: You completed the passage chain and received the Cave Lantern!
supportiveWrong: Not quite. Study the answer and try again next time.
writingSuccess: You wrote it all by yourself!
writingHelp: That is OK. Study the strokes and try again soon.

levelThreeWelcome: Silver Spirits help restore the region. Open Spirit Book to see your Bronze, Silver, and Gold counts.

7: You have seen how Spirits grow. Three filled skill circles make Silver; five make Gold.
Now choose a creature companion in Creatures. Its ability can help you in your next battle.
8: Your partner is ready! Use its ability once each battle when you need a hand.
Silver Spirits can earn room decorations. Open the Restoration Board in My Room to see a set you could finish.
9: You found a set to work toward. Offering it restores part of the region without using up your Spirits.
Open Adventure. It remembers your story and requests so you can find your next task.
10: You can return to Adventure whenever you forget who needs help.
Open Daily Board to see optional goals that can earn a reward chest.
11: The board remembers your goals. There is no timer, and you can leave them for another day.
Open Bag and look for your supplies. They can help when the road gets difficult.
12: You found your supplies. Healing food helps during battle; Repellent helps you walk past encounters.
Open Hero Status to check your HP and gear, then visit its Craft Table.
13: You found the recipes. When a recipe is ready, you can turn its materials and coins into gear, then equip it in Hero Status.
Try one word in Dictation Practice. It helps you prepare for the test at the next-region gate; Show me how can help.
14: You tried writing from memory. You can practise here again before a gate test.
Buy Forest Repellent and exact-word Spirit Bait at the Shop: one helps you travel, the other helps you find a chosen Spirit.
15: Your supplies are ready! Use Repellent from Bag on a fog route. Bait works at the next encounter in its lesson area.
You do not need to remember everything now. Follow Next step; I have left short notes where these features can help. Have fun exploring!

reminders.companion: Your partner can help right now. Tap its ability when you need it; you can use it once each battle, including boss battles.
reminders.restoration: This set is ready! Silver means three filled skill circles; Gold means five. Restore the region to earn its decoration. You keep every Spirit.
reminders.crafting: You have enough materials and coins for this recipe. Craft the gear if you want its benefit, then equip it in Hero Status.
reminders.equipment: This gear is yours, but is not equipped. Tap Equip to use the benefit shown on its card.
reminders.dailyChest: Your three goals are complete! Open the Daily Chest to collect your rewards.
reminders.gateDictation: This gate checks writing from memory. If you want practice first, return to School for Dictation Practice. Show me how is available while practising.
reminders.repellent: Want a quieter walk? Use Forest Repellent here to pause encounters for a while. It stays in your Bag until you use it.
